gaps: This bounded pass does not exhaust every organization within the three NPA service regions.
No individual affiliation or membership is inferred from organizational discovery.
Follow-on targets remain limited to public organization/project/partner relationships.

classification_rules: Do not infer individual political affiliation from organization proximity, attendance, public role or area-code locality.
Do not label an organization anarchist absent explicit organization-level self-description.
Reuse canonical organization identities when already present; an overlay or new NPA is not a new organization.
Treat public organizational contacts only as organization-level evidence and do not enrich private-person data.
Anonymous or collective structures do not require fabricated person records.

findings.notes: La Colectiva NTX and Fort Worth Community Collaborative have current first-party North Texas/Fort Worth public organization surfaces; neither is relabeled anarchist.
Reused canonical Northern Virginia Mutual Aid Working Group and added current 2026 Arlington distribution evidence for the 703/571 overlay.
Reused canonical Athens Mutual Aid Network and added current August 2026 public financial/activity evidence for the 706/762 overlay.

data.method: Recomputed the durable shard-B backlog against current NANPA in-service geographic reporting, selected the next three unresolved NPAs in numeric order, searched the existing corpus before external discovery, preferred current first-party/public institutional sources, reused canonical identities for Northern Virginia Mutual Aid and Athens Mutual Aid Network, and created new organization records only for uncatalogued current public organizations.
data.research_question: Which public organizations relevant to the anarchist-violence corpus are discoverable or reusable from the next unresolved authoritative shard-B U.S. geographic NPAs 682, 703 and 706?
